rationale: Oryx Midstream and Oryx Midstream Services are duplicate labels for one Stonepeak investment whose current operating boundary is OMSPB's 35% interest in the Plains-operated POPB joint venture. The continuing 35% interest and Stonepeak attribution are directly supported through 2026. QIA's 2019 minority entry is proven, but its ownership status at the cutoff remains unresolved.
recommendedChanges: Merge Oryx Midstream Services into the canonical Oryx Midstream record once the current QIA ownership question is adjudicated.
Set the active asset boundary to OMSPB's 35% interest in Plains Oryx Permian Basin and retain Plains' 65% operator position as related joint-venture ownership.
Keep Oryx Midstream Holdings, Middle Cadence and OMSPB as legal-chain entities and POPB as the underlying joint venture rather than separate PortCos.
Treat the 2019 QIA transaction as a proven closed entry but do not present QIA as current without direct cutoff evidence.
Supersede ledger:0430:oryx-midstream-services:8b062bed only after the canonical merge and ownership treatment are approved and released.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether Qatar Investment Authority still held any indirect OMSPB interest at the cutoff.
Exact Stonepeak/QIA sponsor percentages and governance above OMSPB.
